messages: maya: Pushed a new mock for API Keys — focused on bulk rotate, revoke warnings, and the empty state. Need quick UX + a11y pass. figma: https://figma.com/file/jkl012 (placeholder) eli: Saw it. Quick thought: bulk actions need explicit CTAs: `Rotate selected keys` vs `Rotate key`. List context makes single-word CTAs ambiguous. jordan: We should surface owner/team badge per key (e.g., `team: payments`) so someone knows which org will be affected by rotate/revoke. rachel: Audit link request: add a small `View audit` entry on each key row that opens the logs filtered for that key. Helps when deciding whether to rotate. sam: Keyboard flow: when rotating multiple keys, modal focus should start on the confirmation checkbox, then primary CTA. After success, focus should move to the toast's `View audit` or `Copy` depending on context. nora: A11y: announce bulk operations via aria-live: "Rotation complete for 3 API keys. See audit logs for details." And never speak raw keys. If we auto-copy a new key, announce "API key copied to clipboard." maya: For bulk rotate UX, can we show a dry-run that lists affected services (first 5 + "and N more")? That reduces accidental breakage. eli: Also, bulk rotate might need rate limiting or a backend job. From copy POV, primary confirm line: "This will create new keys and invalidate the current ones. Update any services that use them." jordan: On revoke I like a two-tier confirmation: simple revoke for keys with zero usage, typed confirm or checkbox for keys with 2+ linked services. rachel: Suggest adding a small inline link "What happens on revoke?" that expands a 2-line explanation and links to docs with examples. sam: Implementation note: backend returns usageCount. Frontend snippet for dry-run: ``` const preview = await api.post('/keys/preview-rotate', { ids: selected }) showPreview(preview) ``` Make sure preview is cached for 60s. nora: Visual indicators: don't rely on color alone for `danger` or `expired` states. Add icons and `aria-label` on chips: e.g., `⚠️` maya: Empty state copy idea: current is bland. Try: "No API keys yet — create one to start sending requests. Rotate or revoke later from this list." CTA: `Create API key` and small link `Learn about scopes`. eli: Also show a tiny example snippet in empty state: `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer " https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate` so devs see immediate next step. jordan: Scopes UI: show human readable lines like `Read-only — embeddings` instead of cryptic scope tokens. Add a `View raw scopes` toggle for power users. rachel: On telemetry: capture `keys.bulk_rotate_previewed` and `keys.bulk_rotate_confirmed` to see where people back out. sam: Copy UX: button label `Copy new key` and toast message `API key copied to clipboard.` include an accessible role=alert for screen readers. nora: Mobile nuance: require a long-press to reveal the full key or show a 2-step reveal to mitigate shoulder-surfing. Announce that behavior to assistive tech. maya: Great feedback. I'll update Figma: add owner badges, audit links, dry-run preview, typed-confirm for heavy revokes, improved empty state with curl example, and ARIA notes. Filing a ticket KEYUX-501 for implementation and adding the telemetry events. ops-bot: deploy scheduled to staging at 04:00 UTC (automated:deploy) maya: Assigned KEYUX-501 to @sam. ETA: next sprint. Thanks everyone!
